gaps.explanation: The General Fund statement (trimmed p4) prints the transfers gross: Operating Transfers In 349,103 and Operating Transfers Out (157,816), Total Other Financing Sources 191,287. The all-funds budgetary comparison schedule (p8) prints only one net row, Transfers In (out) 191,287 in the General Fund column. That row is detail index 24, +191,287; its original_label says 'Transfers Out' but the amount is a net inflow. 349,103 - 157,816 = 191,287, so the schedule nets the transfers and the gaps are +157,816 here and +157,816 on transfers_out. The schedule does not print the gross amounts, so there is no schedule line to add.

The statement (p4) prints Operating Transfers Out (157,816). The schedule (p8) prints only the net Transfers In (out) 191,287 (= 349,103 - 157,816), detail index 24, so no transfer-out row is printed on the schedule. The two pages report transfers on different bases (gross vs net). There is no fix.

The statement figure comes from the accrual proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p6): Total Operating Disbursements 3,030,618 + Other Expense 13,388 + Interest expense 25,311 = 3,069,317 (includes depreciation 351,891 and amortization 154). The cash-basis budgetary schedule (p8) prints the Combined Utilities Fund Total disbursements as 3,305,656: Public works 3,030,618 + Capital outlay 3,475,926 + Debt service (3,200,888), where the debt service figure is net of loan proceeds. 3,305,656 - 3,069,317 = 236,339. The schedule is on another basis than the statement, so there is no fix.
